events.title: 🎮 Greedy - Devs & Friends Co-op Gameplay (pre-recorded)
events.summary: 🪙🦝 Greedy is part of Steam Next Fest! Watch the devs and some friends play the demo in online co-op. The free demo is out now, so grab your friends and give it a try! ⭐ If you enjoy it, please wishlist Greedy. It really helps a small indie team like ours. 💛 💬 Drop by and say hi Discord!

events.title: GREEDY DEMO OPEN!! 🔵
events.summary: ⛩️THE DUNGEON IS OPEN ⛩️ The Greedy Demo is available now on Steam.Play solo or team up with up to seven friends. Enter the ruins together, steal everything you can and try to leave with the same number of raccoons you brought in.DESCEND TO FLOOR -3 🦝🏃‍♂️‍➡️🛗Every descent reshuffles the dungeon. Rooms, optional paths, traps, enemies and rewards change between runs, forcing the team to explore and adapt. The demo includes a complete descent to Floor -3. events.title: Greedy Playtest #3 is LIVE 🟡
events.summary: Playtest 3 is open right now and closes on September 6th at 23:59 CEST. Hit Request Access on the store page and you are in. Four months since Playtest 2, and honestly it is not the same game any more. New dungeon, new enemies, new run, new reasons to keep the coins you steal. Here is what is waiting for you down there. 🏚️ A whole new dungeonFloors are built room by room now, not stitched out of corridors: bigger, better connected, and with optional rooms worth the detour.
